import Analysis.Real.Indicator
import MeasureTheory.Measure.Integrable
import ProbabilityTheory.MGF

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} 
  (h : 0 ∈ interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ)) (n : ℕ) : 
  iteratedDeriv n (ProbabilityTheory.mgf X μ) 0 = ∫ (x : Ω), (X ^ n) x ∂μ := by
  have h_mgf_def : ProbabilityTheory.mgf X μ = λ t, ∫ (x : Ω), exp (t * X x) ∂μ :=
    rfl
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := λ t, ∫ (x : Ω), exp (t * X x) ∂μ
  have h_f_diff : ∀ k, differentiableOn ℝ f (-∞) ∞ :=
    by { intro k, exact measurable_integrable_exp_set.mgfdiff k h }
  have h_f_n_deriv : iteratedDeriv n f 0 = ∫ (x : Ω), (X ^ n) x ∂μ :=
    by {
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, iteratedDeriv_zero],
      refine (differentiableOn_iteratedDeriv_at f (-∞) ∞ n 0).symm.trans _,
      apply differentiableOn_iteratedDeriv_at,
      { exact h_f_diff n },
      { intros t h_t,
        have h_cont : ContinuousAt f t :=
          by { rw continuousAt, exact (measurable_integrable_exp_set.mgfcont t h).continuousAt },
        have h_cont_deriv : ContinuousAt (f') t :=
          by { rw continuousAt, exact (measurable_integrable_exp_set.mgfcont' t h).continuousAt },
        have h_cont_deriv_n : ContinuousAt (iteratedDeriv n f) t :=
          by { intros, apply differentiableOn_continuousAt, exact h_f_diff n },
        exact h_cont_deriv_n h_t }
    }
  exact h_f_n_deriv
